title: Lorenzo Flournoy and Dootsie Williams of Dootone Records
summary: Flournoy played piano, and trumpeter Dootsie Williams later ran Dootone Records, selling party records and others from the back of his car.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Uh huh. Lorenzo Flournoy played what?
Trumpet. Dootsie Williams was the guy that had a record company called Dootone Records or Dootone or something.
And he had all those Redd Foxx things; those party records, you know. And he had some good things
on his label that he used to sell out the back of his car.
Doesn't he still have Dooto Records?
There's a Dooto Music Center, I know.
Yeah, he does, yeah. That's out in Compton, they call that? Or Watts?
I thought it was in Watts, I'm not sure.
Well, you know, since the riots, everything south of Adams now is Watts. It used to start at 111th street, you know?
